title: Mobile app store releases
description: For an app published on the App Store or Google Play: privacy disclosures, account deletion, build numbers, signing keys and staged rollout.

sources.title: Apple, App privacy details on the App Store
Play Console Help, provide information for Google Play's Data safety section
Play Console Help, understanding Google Play's app account deletion requirements
App Store Connect Help, release a version update in phases
Play Console Help, release app updates with staged rollouts

rules.instruction: When a change adds collected data, a new purpose or a third-party SDK, ask the privacy owner to update the App Store privacy details and the Google Play Data safety form before release.
rules.verification: Link the updated store answers in the release record and compare them with the SDK list and the data the change sends.

rules.instruction: If the app lets users create an account, provide an in-app path to delete the account and its data, and a web link for Google Play.
rules.verification: Run the deletion flow on a test account and check that the backend removes or anonymizes the account data as the privacy policy states.

rules.instruction: Increase the Android `versionCode` and the iOS build number (`CFBundleVersion`) for every build uploaded to a store.
rules.verification: Compare the build numbers of the release candidate with the last uploaded build in App Store Connect and Play Console.

rules.instruction: Keep the upload key and keystore passwords out of the repository, in the approved secret store, and enroll the app in Play App Signing.
rules.verification: Check `git ls-files` for keystore or provisioning files and confirm the release job reads signing material from the secret store.

rules.instruction: Release updates with an App Store phased release and a Google Play staged rollout, with crash and error thresholds that pause the rollout.
rules.verification: Record the rollout percentages, the thresholds and who can pause or halt the release in the release plan.
